0022600091.text: Both teams open their 2026-27 seasons when the Houston Rockets host the Dallas Mavericks. Houston's Julian Phillips (illness) and Steven Adams (calf soreness) are day-to-day and listed as game-time decisions, while Dallas is missing Caleb Martin (thumb sprain), Dereck Lively II (foot surgery), Santi Aldama (knee), and Tarik Biberovic (heel), all listed as out. The teams split their four 2025-26 meetings 2-2, and the most recent was a 111-107 Rockets win in Houston on January 31, 2026.
